file_id: Sudipta Kumar Jana vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 3 November, 2022

sentences.text: Sudipta Kumar Jana vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 3

Author: Moushumi Bhattacharya
Bench: Moushumi Bhattacharya
03.11.2022 sayandeep Wpa 18502 of 2022 Sudipta Kumar Jana
-Versus-
The State of West Bengal & Ors.

Mr. Partha Pratim Roy Mr. Keshab Chandra Das Ms. Aparajita
Mondal Mr. Biplab Adak .....for the petitioner Mr. Amal Kr. Sen Ms. Ashima Das (Sil) .....for the
State

The petitioner is aggrieved by an order of the Additional District Magistrate (Panchayat),
Howrah dated 21st June, 2022 by which the petitioner has been directed to pay a fine of Rs.
50,000/-.
Learned counsel appearing for the State submits that the impugned order is appealable under The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Upon considering the relevant provisions of the said Act, Sections 70 and 71 of the said Act provide for establishment of a Food Safety Appellate Tribunal of the procedure by which the Tribunal shall function.
By a latest Circular issued on 17th January, 2022, a Presiding Officer has also been appointed to the Appellate Tribunal.
Since the Appellate Tribunal is functioning as on date, the petitioner is given liberty to approach such Tribunal.
WPA 18502 of 2022 is disposed of on the above basis.

(Moushumi Bhattacharya, J.)
